overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and maintain executive session minutes. No further relief was ordered because the Board recreated what it could and committed to compliance; the withholding of remaining minutes was a reminder only.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to provide executive session minutes he requested for meetings in 2008-2009 concerning his case and a cranberry bog lease.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that, by failing to create and maintain minutes of executive sessions, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 39, §§ 23A-C.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not respond to his request for executive session minutes within the required 10 days under the current law's release provision.
allegations.key_passage: The Board also did not comply with this requirement, because certain minutes did not exist and others could not easily be located.

allegations.summary: Board was withholding some executive session minutes citing ongoing litigation; the AG reminded the Board of its periodic review and release duties. No finding was made.
allegations.key_passage: we remind the Board that the Open Meeting Law allows a public body to withhold executive session meeting minutes only as long as disclosure of such minutes would defeat the lawful purpose for the executive session.
